column1: # Covers brands originating/headquartered in the Republic of Ireland: stout, whiskey, food and dairy, retailers,
# banks, airlines and aircraft lessors, tech and internet, media, pubs, hotels, GAA/League of Ireland/rugby clubs.
# Northern Ireland brands (Bushmills, Belleek, Wrightbus...) are in GB.tsv.
# Sources: own knowledge (most entries); checked against Wikipedia "List of companies of Ireland", "Category:Irish brands",
# "Category:Food and drink companies of Ireland", "Category:Retail companies of Ireland", "Category:Irish whiskey",
# "Category:Distilleries in the Republic of Ireland", "Category:Software companies of Ireland", ISEQ 20 constituents.
# Hangul: Korean media usage where it exists, otherwise 외래어 표기법 (English; Irish-language names by Irish pronunciation).
